subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Should the July 21, 2026 release retain compatibility records whose registered `removeAfter` date is July 24–30, 2026, or should this sweep land only after each recorded deadline?
rationale: The registry date is an externally visible compatibility commitment, while intentionally ending it early is a release-policy decision that cannot safely be inferred from this PR body alone.

options.title: Honor recorded removal dates
options.body: Restore or defer all surfaces with future `removeAfter` dates and merge only the records whose windows have elapsed.

options.title: Approve an earlier breaking release
options.body: Explicitly authorize early removal and publish a clear upgrade notice for every affected external plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Honor recorded removal dates
recommendation.body: Restore or defer all surfaces with future `removeAfter` dates and merge only the records whose windows have elapsed.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor assembled the compatibility sweep and is the clearest available routing candidate for the registry and release-timing decision.
